title: Device validation gate for 1.0
lead: This is the go/no-go gate for publishing 1.0. Afterwards, merge `first` → `main`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The Manual QA Checklist in DEVELOPERS.md has never been executed, and the rebuild has never run on a device.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - Any failure found becomes a new slice via `slicer add`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Run the release build on these emulators: API 26 (minSdk), API 30, API 33 (notification permission), the target API, and one physical device.
2. Use the checklist from DEVELOPERS.md, extended with:
   - quick-log and undo
   - midnight rollover
   - pickers
   - archive, restore, and delete
   - charts and calendar
   - save-to-file export, and import confirmation with a safety copy
   - reminder tap-through, and the timezone change
   - reboot persistence of reminders
   - TalkBack
   - 200% font scale
   - dark and light mode
3. Record pass or fail per item with `slicer note`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Every checklist item passes on every listed API level.
- `slicer list --json` shows no open MVP-group items.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit on `first`, message `S22: <summary>`. Merging `first` into `main` and tagging `v1.0.0` happens only on the owner's instruction.
